test_title: PYST 26: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose ‘No improvement’ as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

The teacher __had reading the__ instructions aloud to the students.
solution:
The correct answer is "**had read the**." 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is in past perfect tense.
 
• It is used to make it clear that one event happened before another in the past. 
 
• **The formula for the past perfect tense is had + [past participle]. **
 
• **The correct past participle form of 'read' is 'read'.**
 
• Therefore, the correct option is 'had read the'.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**
